Layout map layer objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_map_layer.Rd

The object for an element of the layers list of the layout's map (go_map()). go_map_layer() creates one, with exactly its properties; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_map_layer(
  ...,
  below = NULL,
  circle = NULL,
  color = NULL,
  coordinates = NULL,
  fill = NULL,
  line = NULL,
  maxzoom = NULL,
  minzoom = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  opacity = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  sourceattribution = NULL,
  sourcelayer = NULL,
  sourcetype = NULL,
  symbol = NULL,
  templateitemname = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  visible = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

below

Determines if the layer will be inserted before the layer with the specified ID. If omitted or set to ”, the layer will be inserted above every existing layer. String.

circle

A go_map_layer_circle() object or named list, with properties radius (see go_map_layer_circle()).

color

Sets the primary layer color. If `type` is "circle", color corresponds to the circle color (map.layer.paint.circle-color) If `type` is "line", color corresponds to the line color (map.layer.paint.line-color) If `type` is "fill", color corresponds to the fill color (map.layer.paint.fill-color) If `type` is "symbol", color corresponds to the icon color (map.layer.paint.icon-color) Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

coordinates

Sets the coordinates array contains [longitude, latitude] pairs for the image corners listed in clockwise order: top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left. Only has an effect for "image" `sourcetype`. Any value.

fill

A go_map_layer_fill() object or named list, with properties outlinecolor (see go_map_layer_fill()).

line

A go_map_layer_line() object or named list, with properties dash and width (see go_map_layer_line()).

maxzoom

Sets the maximum zoom level (map.layer.maxzoom). At zoom levels equal to or greater than the maxzoom, the layer will be hidden. Number in the interval [0, 24].

minzoom

Sets the minimum zoom level (map.layer.minzoom). At zoom levels less than the minzoom, the layer will be hidden. Number in the interval [0, 24].

name

When used in a template, named items are created in the output figure in addition to any items the figure already has in this array. You can modify these items in the output figure by making your own item with `templateitemname` matching this `name` alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). Has no effect outside of a template. String.

opacity

Sets the opacity of the layer. If `type` is "circle", opacity corresponds to the circle opacity (map.layer.paint.circle-opacity) If `type` is "line", opacity corresponds to the line opacity (map.layer.paint.line-opacity) If `type` is "fill", opacity corresponds to the fill opacity (map.layer.paint.fill-opacity) If `type` is "symbol", opacity corresponds to the icon/text opacity (map.layer.paint.text-opacity) Number in the interval [0, 1].

source

Sets the source data for this layer (map.layer.source). When `sourcetype` is set to "geojson", `source` can be a URL to a GeoJSON or a GeoJSON object. When `sourcetype` is set to "vector" or "raster", `source` can be a URL or an array of tile URLs. When `sourcetype` is set to "image", `source` can be a URL to an image. Any value.

sourceattribution

Sets the attribution for this source. String.

sourcelayer

Specifies the layer to use from a vector tile source (map.layer.source-layer). Required for "vector" source type that supports multiple layers. String.

sourcetype

Sets the source type for this layer, that is the type of the layer data. One of "geojson", "vector", "raster", "image".

symbol

A go_map_layer_symbol() object or named list, with properties icon, iconsize, placement, text, textfont and textposition (see go_map_layer_symbol()).

templateitemname

Used to refer to a named item in this array in the template. Named items from the template will be created even without a matching item in the input figure, but you can modify one by making an item with `templateitemname` matching its `name`, alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). If there is no template or no matching item, this item will be hidden unless you explicitly show it with `visible: true`. String.

type

Sets the layer type, that is the how the layer data set in `source` will be rendered With `sourcetype` set to "geojson", the following values are allowed: "circle", "line", "fill" and "symbol". but note that "line" and "fill" are not compatible with Point GeoJSON geometries. With `sourcetype` set to "vector", the following values are allowed: "circle", "line", "fill" and "symbol". With `sourcetype` set to "raster" or "image", only the "raster" value is allowed. One of "circle", "line", "fill", "symbol", "raster".

visible

Determines whether this layer is displayed Logical.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_layout_map_layer object (a named list).

Details

Nested objects are named lists, or objects of the constructors their arguments name. Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when the object is created or modified. A property may be a one-sided formula (color = ~col): it is kept, and evaluated in the data (then checked) when its trace is added to a figure with add_<trace>() or add_trace().

Examples

quakes |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scattermap(lat = ~lat, lon = ~long) |>
  update_layout(
    map = go_map(layers = list(go_map_layer(color = "red")))
  )
